description: This cycle or walk follows the Dyserth to Prestatyn Walkway in Denbighshire. The route follows a disused railway line that once served local mines and quarries. Starting in Dyserth the trail follows a surfaced path north to Prestatyn, passing Meliden and Graig Fawr on the way. You could climb the hill for some excellent views over the area if you have time.In Dyserth there's also theDyserth Waterfall Walkand a 16th century church to see.
